explication: Oh-my-rime is a configurable Rime input-method bundle: users install its configuration and deploy it in a Rime engine, then choose among Chinese input schemes and platform-specific presentation settings. The README documents scheme selection, dictionary imports, custom overrides, Hamster 9-key use, and Lua-based features. Source excerpts were not provided, so runtime wiring beyond these documented relationships is omitted.
